reason: I already have a LARQ that works fine, so I don't need another filtered bottle from a brand I've never heard of. And $68 up front to sign up for a filter subscription feels like a lot for something I already own.
objection: Never heard of Claro. For close to LARQ money, plus a subscription, it could easily be a rebadged generic bottle with a creator's name on it.
would_change_my_mind: Independent lab results showing what the filter actually removes, plus a no-questions return if I don't like it versus my LARQ.
